blocks.source: 张巍GRE填空机经2000题 · Test 131 Section 2
blocks.noteTail: （原题及配套答案，仅供个人学习；暂不附讲解）

stem: The standard wisdom now is that sciences undergo periodic ruptures so thorough that the generations of scientists on either side of the break express themselves in mutually ____ languages.

The title of Felsenstein’s book-Inferring Phylogenies-is positively (i)____. The volume achieves so much more than simply presenting methods for inferring phylogenies, being, in fact, (ii)____ of how to analyze evolutionary data from a phylogenetic perspective.
colsZh: 全面得令人赞赏的讨论

stem: Penrose is (i)____ theoretical physicists for engaging in (ii)____ by (iii)____ what is implied by the known data. One of his favorite examples is inflationary cosmology, which, according to him, is treated as an established theory despite a lack of evidence.

items.answerReviewReason: 校对认为配套答案不可靠
items.explanation: 配套答案为 空(i) C singular among、空(ii) C conjecture、空(iii) C venturing beyond，部分题库网站也这样给。但后一句举的例子是 Penrose 认为暴胀宇宙学“缺乏证据却被当成定论”，说明他是在批评别的理论物理学家超出数据作推测，空(i) 更合理的是 B critical of，其余两空不变。

stem: Most movie sound tracks lean so heavily on a few preprocessed musical devices—those swells of strings and cymbals designed to manipulate our emotions in (i)____ ways-that when a composer (ii)____ a more personal language, the effect is (iii)____: an entire dimension of the film experience is liberated from cliché.
A number of recent pieces of instrumental music are linked by a common feature: the considerable ____ left to the individual performer in the way he or she chooses to play the work.

The fierce drought that is gripping the area-and imminent rationing and steep water price increases-is ____ the area’s deep economic divide, as wealthy communities guzzle water while poorer communities nearby conserve by necessity.
Wilson sees the ideas that he presents in his new book as being notably ____, but his critics, by contrast, claim that they are actually rather conventional.
optsZh: 令人畏惧的，望而生怯的
